description: The figure displays four pie charts comparing the distribution of answer refusal categories across four language models on FACTBENCH: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart contains labeled segments with their corresponding counts and percentages. The GPT4-o chart has two slices: a large red slice labeled “Lack of Knowledge” at 83.3% and a smaller orange slice labeled “Safety” at 16.7%. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has five slices: an orange slice for “Misinformation” at 38.4%, a red slice for “Safety” at 9.3%, a blue slice for “Lack of Knowledge” at 22.1%, a light blue slice for “Ethical Advice” at 16.3%, and a yellow slice for “Clarification” at 14.0%. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has two slices: a large orange slice for “Lack of Knowledge” at 75.0% and a smaller red slice for “Clarification” at 25.0%. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart has two equal-sized slices: a red slice for “Misinformation” at 50.0% and an orange slice for “Lack of Knowledge” at 50.0%. All charts include percentage labels inside their respective slices and are visually ordered with the largest segment typically placed at the bottom right.
caption_used: The figure presents four pie charts comparing the distribution of answer refusal categories across four language models on FACTBENCH. The 'GPT4-o' chart shows two categories, with 'Lack of Knowledge' accounting for approximately 70% and 'Safety' making up 30%. The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart highlights 'Misinformation' as the largest category at 45%, followed by 'Lack of Knowledge' at 20%, 'Ethical Advice' at 15%, and 'Clarification' at 10%, with 'Safety' being the smallest category at 10%. The 'Llama3.1-70B-Instruct' chart indicates 'Lack of Knowledge' as the dominant category at 80%, while 'Clarification' accounts for 20%. Finally, the 'Llama3.1-405B-Instruct' chart shows an equal distribution between 'Misinformation' and 'Lack of Knowledge,' each comprising 50%. These charts provide insights into the varying tendencies of language models to refuse answers based on different categories.
